source: sars-guide:SARS ETI page, "Employment Tax Incentive (ETI)" (table from 1 April 2025; "grossed up to 160 hours ... grossed down in the same ratio"), fetched 2026-11-08; ETI Act s4(1)(b)(ii) as amended from 1 April 2025
notes: June 2025, employee aged 24, employed since 1 March 2025 (month 4), R5 000 for 120 hours (R41.67 an hour, above the R28.79 minimum wage). Gross up to 160 hours: 5 000 x 160/120 = 6 666.67. April 2025 table, first 12 months: R5 500 - R7 499.99 is R1 500 - 75% x (6 666.67 - 5 500) = 625.00. Gross down: 625.00 x 120/160 = 468.75. The calculator has no hours and takes the R2 500-R5 499.99 flat band: R1 500.00. PAYE nil (60 000 below 95 750); UIF 50.00; SDL 50.00; net 4 950.00. NAMED LIMIT: the ETI guide section (5.3) is not fetched; the SARS page wording and the Act s4(1)(b)(ii) text are the sources. eti-year2-flat-5000 is the existing year-2 case.
